verdict.rationale: Name.com documents bulk search: a site 'Bulk Search' option and an API availability check covering up to 50 domains per call. A community user also reports a built-in bulk tool for changing nameservers on 50 domains at once. Registration and transfer are only documented as per-domain API operations, and there is no evidence of bulk renewal. missing for 10: bulk registration, bulk renewal, bulk transfer-in, first-party documentation of bulk nameserver changes.

support.subject: As a power user managing a portfolio, bulk operations are real — bulk search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, and transfers across many domains at once

citations.quote: Checks whether up to 50 domain names are purchasable
They have a very convenient way to do bulk changes, so you can select 50 domains at once, and tell name.com to change all of them to your name servers.
